name: goertzel_bank
algorithm: windowed Goertzel recurrence + terminal power, compared against an independent direct DFT
window_format: unsigned16 Q1.15 in [0,32768], per sample index
coefficient_format: signed19 Q3.16 in [-131072,131072]; quantized coefficient defines the recurrence frequency
rounding: nearest-even at /32768 window, /65536 recurrence and terminal coefficient product; sign symmetric
state: signed40 s1/s2 per bin, cleared at every block boundary; |s| < 2^31 bound, saturation+error unreachable with legal parameters
power: unsigned80 unnormalized sample-LSB squared; negative/zero clip and >2^80 clamp mark sticky block error
configuration: atomic valid/ready at clean block boundary only; illegal fields reject the whole request; mid-block assertion held not accepted
multiplier: one shared signed48x48 shift-add, 48 steps; no II1 claim
block_end_cycles: first output = last_input + 251 + 50*bins; subsequent bin rises every 201 cycles unstalled; block pitch >= N*(51+50*bins) + bins*201
remaining: saturation/clip paths are structural only under legal parameters
side-channel or streaming-rate use is unqualified
